hints.text: The middle value can only be found once the numbers are written from least to greatest.
In order the list is $2, 5, 7, 9, 11$. Five values means the third one is in the middle.
The third value is $7$, so the median is $7$.

explanation: Write the numbers from least to greatest, since the median depends on order: $2, 5, 7, 9, 11$.
The list has $5$ values, so the middle one is the $3$rd, with two values on each side.
The $3$rd value in the sorted list is $7$, so the median is $7$.
